about: Greenview No. 16 is a vast municipal district in northwestern Alberta around the separate towns of Valleyview and Fox Creek—not those towns, and not a city. Hamlets include Grande Cache (a former town now in the MD), Grovedale, DeBolt, Landry Heights, Little Smoky, and Ridgevalley, spanning boreal forest, energy country, and the eastern slopes toward Willmore Wilderness. About 9,000 people live in Greenview.
